_comment: Race gear drops (design/gdd/race-gear-sets.md 3.12, design/gdd/drops-and-rewards.md 3.8; Boss 2026-11-13 'remove everything from the old item system'). Every catalog item is a race piece now, so every dropped piece in `slots` (a per-kill item of data/loot/loot.json, a wave chest) keeps its rolled tier and slot and BECOMES the piece of one squad card picked uniformly: that card's race and class (offhand: the card's race shield). Shares stay per (source, wave, tier) but are 1.0 (100%). Gold (legendary) race pieces come ONLY from the boss: a source with no share for a tier listed in `downgrade` gives the piece one tier lower instead (a wave/chest gold becomes purple, PO default 2026-11-13).
